description: Subscribes to an observable and exposes its latest value as a signal, unsubscribing when its injection context is destroyed.
Option of `toSignal` asserting the source emits synchronously (like a `BehaviorSubject`), removing `undefined` from the type.
Turns a signal into an observable that emits its value after change detection settles.
RxJS operator that completes a stream when the current injection context or given `DestroyRef` is destroyed.
A service holding state in a subject with a current value. Common in legacy code and easy to bridge to signals.
